notes: Recovered outboxes must stage successfully before fresh Journey admission. Failed staging or recovered-route delivery leaves the journal unavailable until a later authenticated reconciliation retries it.
Ordinary analytics and shutdown must not wait forever for recovery. An unavailable journal rejects Journey admission; it does not suspend the routing worker indefinitely.
Android serializes journal recovery in its Journey command queue. Routes already owned by the live router are not recovered-route failures: the router may be awaiting that same command queue.
